question: Which of the following games is related to the ‘CONCACAF Gold Cup’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Football.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Football is related to the ‘CONCACAF Gold Cup’.**
 
• The Confederation of North, Central America, and Caribbean Association Football is abbreviated as CONCACAF.
 
• It is one of FIFA's six continental governing bodies for association football.
 
• It is the third-most successful FIFA confederation.
 
• Its 41 member associations represent countries and territories.
